name: Kim Ollivier
story: Kim Ollivier’s professional background combined civil engineering and local-authority technical and management work with GIS consulting. Eagle’s partner directory describes Ollivier & Company’s Esri work for local and regional government. NIWA credits a tool he developed for the Ministry for Primary Industries as the inspiration for its Structured Conservation Planning QGIS plugin, supporting collaborative assessment of marine protected-area proposals in the Ross Sea.

GBS's own retrospective remembers a wider circle around that period including Kim Ollivier, David Pimblott, Mike Oberdries, Simon Jellie and Steve Critchlow. Practitioners met repeatedly as customers, consultants, competitors, conference speakers and collaborators.
